name: synaps-overclocked
description: Haseeb's Synaps plugin stack: session awareness, time injection, the browser dashboard, prompt-cache keepalive, a d20 and a tool-output compressor.

plugins.name: agent-comms
plugins.description: Session awareness: live sessions see each other (busy/idle, claims) and can message each other.

plugins.name: chronos
plugins.description: Injects the current time into LLM context before every user message.

plugins.name: synaps-dash
plugins.description: Browser client for the synaps session daemon (needs bun).

plugins.name: heartbeat
plugins.description: Keeps the Anthropic prompt cache warm during idle gaps with a tiny keepalive turn before the 5-minute TTL.

plugins.name: d20
plugins.description: Rolls a d20 before every user message and injects the result into context.

plugins.name: crush
plugins.description: Native Rust tool-output compressor (after_tool_call). Built on install with cargo (needs a Rust toolchain).
